description: Los Angeles-based fashion jewelry brand selling handcrafted, bohemian-inspired necklaces, earrings, bracelets and rings for women; its affiliate program runs on Impact.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Ettika's program on the Impact platform at 8% per sale and describes Ettika as a Los Angeles-based fashion jewelry brand specialising in handcrafted bohemian-inspired accessories.

Lasso's directory lists Ettika at 6% per sale with a 30-day cookie, while Shopper lists a 3.99% payout. Because the published sources conflict (8% vs 6% vs 3.99%), commission_rate is null and the conflict is documented here; the network (Impact) is consistently reported.
Shopper's partnership listing for ettika.com (United States) quotes a payout rate of 3.99% per sale — the third conflicting figure for this program.

name: Ettika

reasons.compensation: Published rates conflict across directories (8%, 6% and 3.99%), so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low until the brand confirms current terms on Impact.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email found; access runs through the Impact marketplace listing only.
reasons.credibility: An established Los Angeles jewelry brand with a long-running network affiliate program and wide retail/editorial presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Affordable fashion jewelry is a staple of fashion and GRWM creator content, and the brand is pitched at influencers by directories.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact; approval is at the brand's discretion.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running network affiliate program aimed at jewelry bloggers and influencers, but no public ambassador or creator community layer was found on the brand's own pages.

description: Direct-to-consumer men's jewelry brand specialising in gold and silver chains, bracelets, rings and pendants; it runs affiliate campaigns on Impact, including a dedicated JAXXON - Creator campaign.

evidence.summary: Impact's own advertiser page for JAXXON shows a 'JAXXON - Creator' campaign with an Online Sale payout of 15% and a 30-day referral period, and states JAXXON has partnered with Impact; it describes JAXXON as a leading men's jewelry and accessory brand with a strong tastemaker, influencer and athlete following.

LinkClicky lists JAXXON on the Impact platform at 4% per sale for the standard program. Because Impact's own Creator campaign page shows 15% while the directory figure for the standard listing is 4%, the applicable rate depends on the campaign, so commission_rate is null and both figures are documented here.

Acceleration Partners' announcement confirms JAXXON is a leader in men's jewelry with over 20,000 five-star reviews and nearly one million customers, selling direct to consumers, and that its affiliate program offers monthly newsletters, promotional creative and exclusive offers aimed especially at content affiliates.

name: Jaxxon

reasons.compensation: Impact's own page shows 15% for the Creator campaign while a directory lists 4% for the standard program, so no single rate is recorded; the Creator campaign terms are documented in the evidence.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email found; applications run through Impact, with the program managed by Acceleration Partners.
reasons.credibility: Nearly one million customers and 20,000+ five-star reviews per its agency announcement; a category leader in men's chains.
reasons.niche_fit: Men's chains and jewelry are a proven creator category (outfit details, unboxings, gift guides), and the brand runs a campaign explicitly named for creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact, including a dedicated Creator campaign.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated 'JAXXON - Creator' campaign on Impact plus agency materials courting content affiliates show an active creator channel.

reasons.credibility: A major global lingerie brand founded by Rihanna in 2018 with a large membership business.

description: London-founded guided food tour company (Essor Ltd, founded 2013) running small-group food tours with a 'Secret Dish' in cities worldwide; its own affiliate program, managed through Tapfiliate, pays 10% per completed booking and also offers creators gifted tours and paid collaborations.

evidence.summary: The program's own Tapfiliate terms (operated by Essor LTD t/a Secret Food Tours, managed through Tapfiliate) state: standard commission 10% per valid, completed booking, 30-day tracking period, commissions validated within 14 days, payments issued by the last day of the following month, £50 minimum payout, manual approval typically within 72 hours, and the support contact affiliate@secrettours.com.

Secret Food Tours' own affiliate page invites travel bloggers, foodie social creators and publishers: free to join, 10% commission on every booking, 30-day cookie window, dedicated in-house support, plus exclusive bonuses, contests and seasonal promotions.

name: Secret Food Tours

reasons.compensation: 10% per completed booking stated in the program's own terms, with a £50 minimum payout and monthly payment — a solid, fully published tours rate; no cap statement found.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate email (affiliate@secrettours.com) is published in the program's own terms, alongside the public application page.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2013 under Essor Ltd with tours in dozens of cities worldwide and full published affiliate terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Food tours are inherently visual, story-driven travel content, and the brand's own page names travel bloggers and foodie social creators as its target partners.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with manual approval typically within 72 hours per the program terms.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs both an open affiliate program and creator/influencer collaboration routes (gifted tours and paid collabs reported on its own pages).

description: Travel insurance platform selling travel, medical and appliance insurance worldwide from $0.99 per day, with policies for travellers aged 3 to 85; its affiliate offer on Travelpayouts pays 20% of the order amount with a 30-day cookie.

evidence.summary: Travelpayouts' own EKTA program page states the partner receives 20% of the travel insurance rate (worked example: a $100 Standard policy pays the affiliate $20), with partner links, banners and custom ads, and allowed traffic including content projects, social networks and messengers.

Travelpayouts' travel insurance roundup lists EKTA at 20% of the order amount with a 30-day cookie lifetime, deep link generator, pre-made links and banners, joining via Travelpayouts; it notes commission is paid as soon as the insurance policy begins. One minor directory (GistJunction) lists 25%, an outlier against the network's own repeated 20% figure, documented here.
An in-depth review describes EKTA as a Ukrainian travel insurance company founded in 2018 with more than 2 million customers around the world, selling medical and travel coverage online.

name: Ekta

reasons.compensation: 20% of the order amount per Travelpayouts' own program pages — among the highest travel-insurance rates — with payout when the policy begins rather than after the trip; no cap statement found.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email found; contact runs through the Travelpayouts dashboard.
reasons.credibility: A Ukrainian insurer founded in 2018 reporting 2M+ customers, distributed through the established Travelpayouts network.
reasons.niche_fit: Travel insurance is a standard, repeatable recommendation for travel creators, and EKTA's low starting price suits budget-travel audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to join through Travelpayouts with easy approval reported by directories.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program materials explicitly allow social networks, messengers and content projects as traffic sources, though there is no dedicated creator program layer.

description: Flight-compensation claims service (Compensair Pte. Ltd., registered in Singapore, founded 2016) that helps passengers claim up to €600 for delayed, cancelled or overbooked flights on a no-win, no-fee basis; its affiliate program on Travelpayouts pays a flat bounty per confirmed application.

evidence.summary: Travelpayouts' own Compensair program post states the affiliate commission is a flat bounty: a basic 10 euro per confirmed application from all countries except Spain, Turkey, Italy, Romania, Ireland and Greece (5 euro), rising per confirmed claim at 10+ applications depending on the applicant's country (up to 25 euro). Because the program pays flat per-application bounties rather than a percentage — and an older Travelpayouts post quoted 5 euro per claim sent to airlines — commission_rate is null and the flat structure is documented here.

Compensair's own terms name the operator as Compensair Pte.Ltd., a company registered in Singapore, and describe the service: claiming monetary compensation from airlines for flight delay, cancellation and denied boarding, charging clients only on success.

name: Compensair

reasons.compensation: Flat bounties per confirmed application (€10 base, €5 for six listed countries, up to €25 at volume) per Travelpayouts' own program post — predictable per-claim pay, but no percentage rate applies, so none is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email found; contact runs through Travelpayouts.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2016 as a Singapore-registered claims company claiming against 150+ airlines in 60 countries per its own site and reviews.
reasons.niche_fit: Flight-delay compensation is a highly shareable travel-tips topic, and the free eligibility check gives creators an easy call to action.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to join through Travelpayouts with links, banners and a widget provided.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program materials target travel content sites and bloggers; there is no dedicated creator or ambassador layer.
